camera.source: shots/coffee-cup-sam/camera.json (per-frame shift measured from the footage), smoothed with a Gaussian of 2 frames because the measurement holds for 3 frames and then steps

notes.0: the cup is seen from straight above, rim toward the camera, and the inside is dark
notes.8: a dark hand comes in at lower right and the cup starts to tilt; its side shows on the right
notes.16: the cup tilts further, its outer wall now on the right of the rim
notes.24: the cup turns so its side and base point down and to the right
notes.28: most of the side is in view; the rim is pinched into a spout on the left
notes.36: the cup tilts back toward the camera and the empty white inside shows
notes.44: the rim is nearly round again with the bottom visible inside
